title: Sigeon Pex Totem
description: I made a Pigeon Totem for all the Doomscrollers. (Works for 1.20.1+)
body:
I made a Sigeon Pex Totem for all the Doomscrollers on Minecraft.
The Totem is a refrence from Brainrot and is a sideproject of mine.
This Texturepack took quite some Time and no Ai is used for it. 
thanks.
